about: Outdoor noise table (owner C): road emission, traffic defaults, propagation constants, residual background and rail. Octave bands 63..8000 Hz as in acoustics.json.

cnossos_road.about: CNOSSOS-EU road source model, Directive 2002/49/EC Annex II as amended by Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1226, Table F-1. Rows A_R, B_R (rolling), A_P, B_P (propulsion), dB re 1 pW per vehicle at v_ref, reference surface, 20 C. Category 1 light, 2 medium heavy, 3 heavy. Transcribed from the roadnoise 0.1.1 package (machine-checked against EUR-Lex).

road_classes.about: Defaults by OSM highway class for US urban roads when there is no count (C3). aadt: vehicles/day, both directions; heavy: share of trucks (half medium, half heavy); speed: mph when the way has no maxspeed tag.

hourly_traffic_pct.about: Share of daily traffic in each local hour 0..23, typical US urban weekday (shape of the FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide urban profiles). Normalised to 100 when loaded.

propagation.about: ISO 9613-2 screening method. atmosphere: Table 2 at 20 C / 70 % RH, dB/km. Ground: porous (lawns), alternative A-weighted method eq. (10) with D_Omega. Barriers: single edge D_z = 10 lg(3 + 20 z / lambda), at most 20 dB, replacing the ground term. Housing: Annex A.3, 0.1 dB per metre of path through houses times the built-up fraction, at most 10 dB, after the first metres of road corridor. Buildings without a height tag are one-storey Houston houses.

background.about: Residual sound that isn't a modelled road or railway (distant city, AC condensers, insects, birds): ANSI/ASA S12.9-2013 Part 3 Table 2 typical day (07-22) and night (22-07) levels by neighbourhood category. Spectrum shape is a typical urban residual (dB, unweighted, relative).

rail.about: FTA Transit Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment Manual (2018) general assessment for freight: SEL at 50 ft of a diesel locomotive (92 dBA at 50 mph, -10 lg(S/50)) and of each rail car (82 dBA at 50 mph, +20 lg(S/50)); Leq(1h) = SEL + 10 lg(trains per hour) - 35.6. Train counts are defaults, not data for this line; horn noise at grade crossings is not included.

guidelines.about: WHO Environmental Noise Guidelines for the European Region (2018): road traffic Lden 53 dB, Lnight (23-07) 45 dB outside the most exposed facade. WHO Guidelines for Community Noise (1999): bedrooms LAeq 30 dB at night, living rooms 35 dB by day (07-23).
